name: XCC_CB_PERIOD_STATUSES
description: This table stores the periods statuses for control budgets which control when budget is available for consumption.

columns.name: PERIOD_STATUS_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this transaction

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to XCC_CONTROL_BUDGETS table

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Control budget period name user identifier

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Effective period number of the period

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date on which control budget period begins

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date on which control budget period ends

columns.name: QUARTER_NUM
columns.description: Quarter number of the control budget period

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Budget year of the control budget period

columns.name: PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Control budget period number internal identifier

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR
columns.description: Fiscal year of the control budget

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Control budget period status to indicate whether budget activity is allowed

columns.name: BUDGET_EFFECTIVE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Effective period number.  Gaps due to adjustment periods are removed.

columns.name: BUDGET_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Period number.  Gaps due to adjustment periods are removed.

columns.name: FUNDS_RELEASE_ID
columns.description: Temporary processing identifier to group periods when sharing funds across periods. The value is cleared once the process to release pending funds to summary control budget completes successfully.

columns.name: ARCHIVED_BUDGET_ENTRIES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether there are archived budget entries.

columns.name: ARCHIVED_ACTIVITIES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether there are archived activities.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
